'''Tendau Bendon'''<ref name="Chancellors">{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}}</ref> was an [[Ithorian]] [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Coruscant" /> Bendon was one of the many allies of the long-serving [[Anx]] senator [[Horox Ryyder]] alongside Senators [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] and [[Yarua]].<ref name="Chancellors" /> The Ithorian had [[Color|brown]] skin and black [[eye]]s and on at least one occasion wore a red [[Clothing|robe]] while standing with two other Ithorian delegates in a [[repulsorpod]] in the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]] of the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Coruscant" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Tendau Bendon was first identified in the [[2022]] reference book ''[[Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic]]''.<ref name="Chancellors" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Tendau Bendon/Legends|Tendau Bendon]] first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Del Rey]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]''.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
